recommendation.summary: No trainer, net, gate or window change at link 3. Retire the raw-vloss 0.62 flag (a); stop the boundary window collapse with KTG_KEEP_SELFPLAY_GENERATIONS 3 -> 60 before 17:53 EDT (c1); run the 400-game c14 matches latest vs t9-s20919936 and vs t9-s143744 (h). LR x0.5 (b) pre-registered for link 4 iff the match gives p(latest vs s20919936) <= 0.55. Validation split (g) at link 4 after a dry run.

options.name: do nothing to the trainer; retire and redefine the flag
options.mechanism: raw vloss carries the irreducible entropy of the outcome distribution; the rise is explained by the draw / close-game share of the training window; distribution-invariant fit signals (tdvloss1-3, search CE vs outcome, oloss, sloss) are flat or improving
options.expected_effect: no false escalation at the link-3 boundary; the value head stays under watch through invariant signals

options.name: LR scale 0.5
options.mechanism: per_sample_lr = 0.00003 * lr_scale (train.py:1094); weight decay follows as lr_scale^0.75 (train.py:698-700); the loop passes no -lr-scale (train_9x9.sh, synchronous_loop_9x9.sh:512) so the LR has been constant since 2M samples
options.expected_effect: if the 19-export stall is LR-noise-limited: one-time drop in p0loss/vloss and new bests within 2-3 exports; otherwise nothing
options.risk_to_running_chain: irreversible loss of exploration; confounded with the boundary transient if applied at link 3; new variable in the knob file must pass derive_knobs.py --assert-loop-defaults and check_knobs_9x9.py

options.reversible: yes in setting, no in effect

options.name: stop the link-boundary window collapse
options.mechanism: prune_retention.py --apply at link start (loop.sbatch:876) with KTG_KEEP_SELFPLAY_GENERATIONS=3 deleted 52 generations (loop-305318.log:23-71); shuffle.py:414-435 sizes the window from rows on disk, so it fell 421842 -> 109442 rows (loop-305318.log:656) and vloss stepped 0.6002 -> 0.6146 within 1.3 epochs; keeping >= two links of generations makes the window continuous
options.expected_effect: no boundary spike/undershoot at link 3; the 0.62 flag is not crossed by the artefact; ~2 exports per link recovered
options.cost: 20-92 MB per generation retained, ~3-5 GB per link; scratch at 2.9 % of 500 GiB
options.risk_to_running_chain: none; rolling --target-bytes mode is not invoked
options.alternative_future: -add-to-data-rows <rows deleted> on synchronous_loop_9x9.sh:506 (shuffle.py:783) needs a rows-ever counter the loop does not keep

options.name: deliberately larger window
options.mechanism: TAPER_WINDOW_SCALE 50000 -> 200000 (knobs_9x9.env:215) raises the window at 2.6M rows from ~399k to ~582k; SHUFFLE_MINROWS 25000 -> 400000 (:200) raises it to ~734k (shuffle.py:430 adds min_rows back)
options.expected_effect: more, older games per draw at the same reuse; sign of the effect on the value head unknown
options.risk_to_running_chain: changes the training distribution mid-chain and confounds every metric for ~20 cycles; SHUFFLE_MINROWS form makes check_knobs_9x9.py K5 print FAIL (moot mid-run)

options.name: SHUFFLE_KEEPROWS 120000 -> 240000 (or o49 -approx-rows-per-out-file)
options.mechanism: doubles samples per cycle and the applied reuse rho = KEEPROWS/(G r) from 3.9 to 7.8 against the cap of 8 (knobs_9x9.env:178); -approx-rows-per-out-file changes epoch granularity and export cadence, not the window
options.expected_effect: more training on the same data; the opposite of a fresher window
options.risk_to_running_chain: reuse at 97 % of the cap; R14 starvation guard closer

options.name: larger net as a new chain seeded from the current best
options.mechanism: no weight transfer across depths exists in the mirror (migrate_*.py change channels/heads/losses only); seed = copy of the current 36 selfplay generations into runs/p2/selfplay and t9-s26913152 into runs/p2/models as the gate baseline; MODELKIND b8c96h3tfrs (modelconfigs.py:1057, ~+13 % params) or b14c192h6tfrs (:1453, DESIGN section 9 ladder, ~6M params, count before use)
options.expected_effect: the only option that can move a capacity ceiling; unknown until the match says the ceiling is real
options.cost: a second GPU for >= 1 link (23.5 h) before any comparison; b8 +13 % train time; b14c192 several times more and slower selfplay by an unmeasured factor
options.risk_to_running_chain: none (separate BASEDIR) except GPU contention within the cap of 4
options.recommended: only if (h) and then (b) fail to restore progress

options.name: gate bar / match games
options.mechanism: -required-candidate-win-prop 0.55 on synchronous_loop_9x9.sh:471 (gatekeeper.cpp:271 default 0.5, ties to candidate :579) or numGamesPerGating 200 -> 400 (gatekeeper_9x9.cfg:32; SE 0.035 -> 0.025)
options.expected_effect: fewer non-transitive acceptances; no effect on vloss
options.cost: +195 s per gate at 400 games (~+6 % cycle wall)
options.risk_to_running_chain: rejections keep the loop in the one-epoch regime for that cycle; at 0.55 a genuinely +35 Elo candidate is rejected half the time

options.name: stop-and-declare plateau at a defined criterion
options.mechanism: plateau iff no new p0loss/pacc1 best for >= 30 exports AND c14 match p(latest vs best-by-loss) <= 0.55; then final latest-vs-first match and move to (d)
options.expected_effect: converts the stall into a measured decision
